title: Palm Tree Grove at Aterro do Flamengo Park, Rio de Janeiro
description: Rows of towering coconut palms shade the green lawns of Aterro do Flamengo, the waterfront park designed by Roberto Burle Marx along the beach in #Flamengo. Locals picnic, jog and relax under the palms just steps from the sand in #RioDeJaneiro. A tropical green escape for your #Rio itinerary and #Brazil travel board.

title: View Across Guanabara Bay to Niterói from Praia do Flamengo
description: From the quiet sands of #Flamengo, the mountains of Niterói and the entrance to Guanabara Bay stretch across the horizon, with a plane gliding overhead toward Santos Dumont Airport. Calm water, soft white sand and moody blue skies make this a peaceful corner of #RioDeJaneiro. Save this #Rio landscape for your #Brazil travel inspiration.

title: Beach Day at Praia do Flamengo: Red Chairs and Green Umbrellas
description: Red beach chairs and green umbrellas line the sand at #Flamengo, with the hills of Niterói and the historic Santa Cruz Fortress across Guanabara Bay. Sunscreen on, chair rented and the whole afternoon ahead: this is beach culture in #RioDeJaneiro. A relaxed local #Rio beach scene for your #Brazil travel board.

title: Cooling Off Under the Beach Shower at Praia do Flamengo, Rio
description: A splash under the beach shower is the best way to beat the heat on #Flamengo, where locals lounge in beach chairs beside watermelon and Brahma umbrellas. Guanabara Bay sparkles behind as a ship heads out to sea in #RioDeJaneiro. Real, everyday #Rio beach life and Brazilian summer vibes in #Brazil.

title: Sugarloaf Mountain Summit and Cable Car Close-Up, Rio de Janeiro
description: Zoom in on the granite peak of Sugarloaf Mountain and you'll spot the cable car station perched on top, with cables stretching across the sky toward Morro da Urca. Riding the Bondinho Pão de Açúcar is a bucket list experience in #RioDeJaneiro. Save this iconic #Rio landmark for your #Brazil travel itinerary.

title: Christ the Redeemer Above Flamengo Beach, Rio de Janeiro
description: Look up from the sand at #Flamengo and you'll see Christ the Redeemer standing atop Corcovado Mountain, watching over the city of #RioDeJaneiro. Beach showers, sunbathers and stadium lights frame one of the most iconic views in #Rio. A must-see landmark for your #Brazil bucket list.

title: Art Deco Architecture and Palm Trees in Flamengo, Rio de Janeiro
description: Looking up between curved Art Deco facades, bay windows and tall royal palms reveals the elegant mid-century architecture of #Flamengo. These residential streets in #RioDeJaneiro are full of rooftop gardens, ornate balconies and leafy greenery. A beautiful #Rio architecture and urban photography find in #Brazil.

title: Bistrô Sesc Flamengo: Dining in a Historic Mansion Garden in Rio
description: Bistrô Sesc Flamengo serves lunch on a leafy garden patio beside an ornate white mansion with Moorish arches, carved columns and Brazilian and Rio de Janeiro flags. White orchids, tropical plants and historic architecture make it a peaceful lunch spot in #Flamengo. A hidden gem for foodies exploring #RioDeJaneiro, #Rio and #Brazil.

title: Real Gabinete Português de Leitura: Rio's Most Beautiful Library
description: The Neo-Manueline facade of the Real Gabinete Português de Leitura is a masterpiece of carved limestone, Gothic arches, statues and Portuguese and Brazilian flags in downtown #RioDeJaneiro. Home to the largest collection of Portuguese literature outside Portugal, it's free to visit in Centro. A must-see for book lovers and architecture fans in #Rio, #Brazil.

title: Stained Glass Skylight at the Real Gabinete Português de Leitura
description: Look up inside the Royal Portuguese Reading Room to see a glowing octagonal stained glass skylight in blue, red and white, with a grand iron chandelier hanging below. Details like this make the Real Gabinete one of the most magical places in #RioDeJaneiro. Add this #Rio library to your #Brazil travel bucket list.
